title: React app development
subtitle: A practical guide to building fast, modular user interfaces with React and Vite
author: Shiva Raj Paudel
second_image_caption: Building clean and modular UI components in React
excerpt: A beginner-friendly guide to building modern, fast, and scalable React applications from scratch.

content.text: React is one of the most popular JavaScript libraries for building modern user interfaces. By using a component-based approach, it enables developers to build complex, interactive web applications using modular, reusable building blocks.
Why choose React for modern web development?

With React's declarative syntax and virtual DOM, the browser only updates what has actually changed on screen. This results in blazing fast page updates and smooth, seamless user interactions across all devices.

content.caption: Developing components with clean JSX syntax and reactive state.

content.text: Quick Project Setup with Vite

Getting a new project off the ground used to require heavy configuration. Today, Vite allows you to initialize a modern React and TypeScript application in just a few seconds with instant hot reloading.

content.code:
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

content.text: Working with State and Lifecycle

React Hooks like useState and useEffect make managing local state and side effects straightforward. You can encapsulate behavior into custom hooks that can be easily shared across your entire application.
As your project grows, combining modular components, clean state management, and responsive layouts will ensure your codebase remains maintainable for years to come.

title: Mastering CSS Grid Layouts
subtitle: Build responsive magazine-style layouts without writing dozens of media queries
author: Shiva Raj Paudel
second_image_caption: CSS Grid layout tracks and alignment systems
excerpt: CSS Grid is the ultimate 2-dimensional layout system. Learn how to craft responsive layouts effortlessly.

content.text: CSS Grid has fundamentally changed how we approach web layouts. While Flexbox is ideal for single-axis alignment, Grid gives you full control over both rows and columns simultaneously.
Grid Containers and Template Columns
With properties like grid-template-columns and repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)), you can create layouts that automatically adapt to any screen size without writing media queries for every device.

content.caption: Precision control over grid tracks, gaps, and responsive placement.

title: Full Stack Development with Node
subtitle: Architecting clean, reliable backend APIs and static servers with Express
author: Shiva Raj Paudel
second_image_caption: Handling custom slug routing and serving static assets in Express
excerpt: Learn how to build lightweight, fast, and scalable backend services with Express and Node.js.

content.text: Building full-stack web applications requires a dependable server that can serve static assets, handle dynamic routes, and protect client privacy. Express remains the gold standard for simplicity and speed in the Node.js ecosystem.
Structuring Server Middleware and Routes

Express makes it simple to handle custom URL slugs, security headers, and static file delivery. By layering lightweight middleware, you maintain full control over every HTTP request and response cycle.

content.caption: Handling dynamic routes and serving high-performance web pages.

content.text: Handling Custom Slugs
By writing clean parameter-based routes, you can map user-friendly URLs like /React_app_001 directly to your blog reader template without needing complex database queries.
This simplicity gives you the freedom to write blog posts in clean JSON files, commit them to your repository, and publish updates immediately.
